comment: FINDING, recorded not fixed (THE-CONFORMANCE-HARNESS, measured 2026-09-01 at release-v5.2.4): discovery advertises id_token_signing_alg_values_supported [EdDSA, ES256]; OIDC Discovery 1.0 section 3 requires RS256 to be included.
